sourceRefs.locator: CTH 91, entries 91.A and 91.B: KBo 1.7 joins and find contexts at Hattusa
Pp. 593–594, treaty versions, two Hattusa clay witnesses, Karnak and Ramesseum translations and silver document

summary.de: Fragmente akkadischer Tontafeln zum Vertrag zwischen Hattusili III. und Ramses II. Die Konkordanz erfasst unter anderem KBo 1.7 mit Anschlussstücken.
summary.en: Fragments of Akkadian clay tablets recording the treaty between Hattusili III and Ramesses II. The concordance records KBo 1.7 and its joins among the witnesses.
